proposal.reason: Primary change is in the IB network backend: connection metadata/handshake redesign (Connect/Accept ready sync), IB/RoCE routing and QoS handling (FLID, TC/SL/FIFO TC), ECE negotiation, and related net_ib transport behavior updates. Add gin because GIN-specific connect/accept/listen flows were changed to use the new IB handshake/cancel paths and cleanup semantics. Add memory because net_ib now introduces a per-device, reference-counted MR registration cache with new registration/deregistration ownership and lifetime behavior.
